text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho begins! One of the so-called "average" runners, Matikanetannhauser, is a little simpleminded, but easy to get along with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Narita Brian sees the strength that lies within her when Matikanetannhauser declares that she won't lose. Brian responds by resolving to give it her all as well.
